theme.autoHint: Follows your device: day while it is light, night when your screen turns dark.

viewMode.title: Moving between pages
viewMode.swipeHint: A phone turns one page at a time; a computer opens the mushaf as a book of two pages.
viewMode.scrollHint: The pages follow one another as you scroll down, on a phone and a computer.

pageTurn.title: Page-turn animation
pageTurn.hint: The sheet turns over like the printed mushaf. Off: pages change at once.

keepAwake.title: Keep the screen on
keepAwake.hint: The screen stays on while the mushaf is open.

followReciter.title: Follow the reciter
followReciter.hint: The mushaf turns to the page being recited.

immersive.title: Hide the controls while reciting
immersive.hint: On a phone only the ayat stay; a tap brings the controls back.

install.title: Install the mushaf
install.hint: It opens from your home screen like an app and works offline.
install.iosHint: In Safari, tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.

about.body: Drawn with the King Fahd Complex's own page fonts, page by page as in the printed mushaf, unmodified. Open source and free, for everyone who serves the Book of Allah to put into their own site or app.
about.thanks: With thanks to the King Fahd Complex, Tarteel (QUL), Quran.com, EveryAyah and the reciters.
